component: Web typography scale, editorial serif and the CaissaTrainer wordmark
explanation: Owner: nearly every text element had the same importance. A website needs a display scale, section and card titles, body, support, metadata and eyebrow labels, plus an editorial serif for educational and historical content, while navigation, controls and tools keep a readable functional face. The brand wordmark is a deliberate two part composition: Caissa in bold emerald sans, Trainer in a flowing parchment italic serif, one continuous word beside the knight mark. The two colour treatment is a brand element, not a heading style.

classification.rationale: Approved guidance has a type scale for utility interfaces (tokens --fs-xs to --fs-2xl) and no display, editorial or brand typography rules. Gap for any content website.
